{
  "candidate_rtl": "module mux_large (
    input [7:0] block_a, block_b, block_c, block_d, block_e,
    input [7:0] block_f, block_g, block_h, block_i, block_j,
    input [3:0] sel,
    output reg [7:0] block_out
);
    wire hi_00, hi_01, hi_10;
    wire lo_00, lo_01, lo_10, lo_11;
    wire take_a, take_b, take_c, take_d, take_e;
    wire take_f, take_g, take_h, take_i, take_j;

    assign hi_00 = ~sel[3] & ~sel[2];
    assign hi_01 = ~sel[3] &  sel[2];
    assign hi_10 =  sel[3] & ~sel[2];

    assign lo_00 = ~sel[1] & ~sel[0];
    assign lo_01 = ~sel[1] &  sel[0];
    assign lo_10 =  sel[1] & ~sel[0];
    assign lo_11 =  sel[1] &  sel[0];

    assign take_a = (hi_00 & lo_00) |
                    (sel[3] & (sel[2] | sel[1]));
    assign take_b = hi_00 & lo_01;
    assign take_c = hi_00 & lo_10;
    assign take_d = hi_00 & lo_11;
    assign take_e = hi_01 & lo_00;
    assign take_f = hi_01 & lo_01;
    assign take_g = hi_01 & lo_10;
    assign take_h = hi_01 & lo_11;
    assign take_i = hi_10 & lo_00;
    assign take_j = hi_10 & lo_01;

    always @(*) begin
        block_out = (block_a & {8{take_a}}) |
                    (block_b & {8{take_b}}) |
                    (block_c & {8{take_c}}) |
                    (block_d & {8{take_d}}) |
                    (block_e & {8{take_e}}) |
                    (block_f & {8{take_f}}) |
                    (block_g & {8{take_g}}) |
                    (block_h & {8{take_h}}) |
                    (block_i & {8{take_i}}) |
                    (block_j & {8{take_j}});
    end
endmodule
",
  "bottleneck": "The likely critical path is select decoding through data masking and the ten-input output reduction. The default selection of block_a can add select-path logic, while shared select nets require buffering for eight-bit fanout.",
  "rewrite": "Use explicit shared two-bit predecoding and parallel one-hot data masking. Fold all six default select values into the compact block_a enable sel[3] & (sel[2] | sel[1]), combined with its explicit select-zero enable. This exposes a shallow sum-of-products structure without a priority mux chain.",
  "expected_timing_gain": "Targets a modest reduction in select-to-output arrival by simplifying the default decoder and exposing parallel gating. ABC may already derive similar logic from the baseline, so improvement is not guaranteed. No mapped timing or electrical results have been measured.",
  "area_or_other_cost": "Shared predecoding limits duplicated select logic; one-hot enable fanout may require buffers. The structure is intended to remain near baseline area, but compliance with the 1006.089920 um^2 cap and zero electrical violations requires the specified mapping and checking flow.",
  "functional_boundaries": "Preserves the module interface, unsigned widths, combinational operation, and all two-state input/output behavior. Selects 0 through 9 choose block_a through block_j respectively; selects 10 through 15 choose block_a. Enables are mutually exclusive and exhaustive for every two-state select. No storage, latency, assumptions, parameters, or external dependencies are introduced. Four-state X/Z propagation is not claimed equivalent."
}
